title: Follow the Heron Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutFollow the Heron ~ 35 North Ryan Street ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 3-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Follow the Heron is the perfect family vacation destination, located in the quiet Summer's Edge neighborhood, sleeping up to 8 guests with 3 bedrooms, 3 baths PLUS kid's den with bunk bed. 2,060 sf, expansive 2nd floor screened porch, grill deck, no through traffic. Guests have access to TWO community pools and a short, 5-minute stroll to private neighborhood beach. Please note - neighborhood restrictions prohibit golf carts and on-street parking. Ground Floor: 1 bedroom. 1 bath. Living room. Dining table seats 6. Bar seating for 3. Fully equipped kitchen. Pantry. Laundry room. Covered front porch. Rear grill deck. Enclosed outdoor shower. #1 Bedroom has a King bed Full bath with tub/shower Second Floor: 2 bedrooms. 2 baths. Kids den with bunk (2 twins), Screened porch. #2 En-Suite Master Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, double vanity #3 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower #4 "Bedroom" is open kids den with bunk (2 Twins). * Please note – no local channels on bedroom Smart TV’s, streaming services available with guest account login; however, both living room Smart TV's do have YouTube TV for viewing local channels. Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Smart TVs (no local cable in bedrooms; YouTube TV in both living areas), 2 DVD players, board games, puzzles, books, movies. PLEASE NOTE: YouTube TV is available on both living area TV's; all bedroom TV's have access only to NetFlix, Prime, Hulu, etc., with guest login credentials. Distinctive Features Two community pools (one heated in winter/spring) 5-minute walk to beach Spacious screened porch 2 living rooms Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 2 large, or 3 small, vehicles 3 King beds, 1 Bunk (2 Twins), 3 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 3 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor shower, outdoor covered porch, outdoor grill deck, screened porch, outdoor furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, electric range, refrigerator with icemaker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (2.5 miles) WaterColor (3 miles) Grayton Beach (3.5 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
